acceptance: local-review in member mode writes a result naming the base commit, head tree, patch digest, trusted commit and outcome.
An exempt-only member gives not-reviewed, distinct from clear.
A moving ref as trusted ref is refused in member mode.
The cache-key question is settled with evidence: a test shows a trusted-manifest change invalidates the cache, or the item records why the manifests are already covered.
Default pr-open local review behaviour is unchanged (test).
Merged to develop, after a benchbox-oracle success review of its head if it touches soundness paths.
context: Owner decision 2026-11-01 (owner answer in the choice dialog, BenchBox session 01a19729, 2026-11-01): "Same bar as a standalone PR" [option text: an exempt-only member is recorded as not reviewed, distinct from a pass; the final PR's hosted oracle-gate reviews the combined change]. Do not force model reviews of exempt paths. No other decision gate: independent of todo-db. Guardrails: deliver as an ordinary serial PR to develop (AGENTS.md: feature delivery cannot deliver the changes that make it possible); write only from a linked worktree made with make worktree-create and checked with make agent-write-preflight, never the primary clone; stage explicit paths, never git add -A; no explanatory comments or docstrings (COMMENT-POLICY-001, make comment-policy-check); heavy test runs only through lock-taking entry points, never BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK; never weaken hold labels, the unresolved-thread refusal, oracle-gate, duration or suite gates; add a changelog.d fragment (CHANGELOG_INTERNAL when nothing is user-visible); durable artifacts carry no session or phase labels; cited line numbers are leads, so re-read the code before editing; tests prove behaviour, never wiring or wording.
description: Batch members are reviewed with the existing no-PR local reviewer (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/cli.py local-review and local.py). Make it write a machine-readable result bound to the member's base commit, head tree, patch digest and a pinned trusted develop commit. Outcomes are clear, findings, not-reviewed (exempt-only or no changes) and override; exempt-only changes give not-reviewed, never clear (local.py:651-653 prints 'no review needed' today). In member mode the trusted ref must be a full commit SHA, because trusted_ref falls back to the diff base when omitted (local.py:199). Check whether the cache key omits the trusted manifests (local.py:478-491); if it does, add them so a manifest change invalidates the cached result.
